name: square_and_mul
semantics: Broadcast x and y to a common shape, square x elementwise, then multiply the squared values by y.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Floating-point input tensor whose values are squared.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Floating-point multiplier tensor; broadcasting is allowed.

output: A tensor with the broadcast shape of x and y and values equal to torch.square(x) * y.
notes: Use direct multiplication for the square and preserve broadcast-gradient reduction in backward.
